info.name: E-Commerce Backend API (Role-Based)
info.description: Complete production-ready Postman collection for the NestJS E-Commerce backend service organized by Role (Public/Guest, Customer, Seller, and Admin). Configured with automatic token persistence, rich realistic payloads matching class-validator DTOs, and the ngrok live tunnel endpoint.

variable.description: Active API base URL (Defaulted to live ngrok endpoint)
Customer or active user JWT access token
Dedicated JWT access token for Seller role
Dedicated JWT access token for Admin role
